Bihar BPSC APO Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Answer Key for the posts of Assistant Prosecution Officer (APO). This recruitment has been announced for 300 posts. The online application process for BPSC APO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 February 2026, to 20 March 2026. The Examination was conducted on 15 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for BPSC APO Answer Key 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 February 2026
  • Last Date : 20 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 15 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Available
  • Answer Key : 12 August 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
